children: -- Telesat Corporation (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT), one of the world’s largest and most innovative satellite operators, today announced that Telesat and an ad-hoc committee of holders of Telesat GEO Inc.’s term loans, secured notes, and unsecured notes agreed to standstill arrangements, which include that the lenders will not take any enforcement actions through and including January 18, 2027. Telesat agreed in the standstill arrangements to continue to make interest payments during the standstill period.

Telesat’s term loans and certain secured notes mature December 6, 2026. Telesat’s goal remains reaching a fair and consensual resolution. The standstill arrangements afford Telesat additional time to address the upcoming maturities. To that end, Telesat will continue to seek to engage in good faith in respect of the upcoming debt maturities.

Telesat Corporation (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a global satellite operator and leader in advanced satellite communications. Through its Telesat Lightspeed Low Earth Orbit (LEO) network, Telesat is delivering a new generation of high-performance connectivity for telecom, enterprise and government customers. Designed around open standards, Telesat Lightspeed enables seamless integration of high-throughput, low latency satellite services into existing terrestrial networks and operations, extending and augmenting network capabilities with greater control, visibility and assurance. Its advanced, software-defined architecture operates in both commercial and military Ka-band spectrum, enabling secure, resilient broadband communications with protection against evolving threats. Backed by nearly 60 years of innovation and engineering excellence, Telesat is uniquely positioned to help customers solve their most complex communications challenges with scalable and future-ready solutions.
